verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's core interface is prompt/chat-based generation of full apps (code, deploy, DB, payments) via natural language, with community evidence confirming real projects built '99% through prompts' and idea-to-prod workflows. missing for 10: no formal documentation of NL command scope/limits or benchmarked reliability across complex multi-step NL instructions, and some hands-on reports of prompt-driven doom loops/unauthorized changes show partial fragility.
